"""Probe: build one world and time a few guard calls on today's code (scratch, not a test)."""
import shutil
import sys
import tempfile
import time
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-84/tests/acceptance/W2-84")
import w2_84_support as s  # noqa: E402

base = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="w2-84-probe-"))
try:
    t0 = time.monotonic()
    w = s.make_world(base / "trees")
    print(f"world built in {time.monotonic() - t0:.2f} s")
    st = s.make_store_world(base / "store")
    print("store revs", st.revs)
    other = w.tree(s.WT_OTHER)
    calls = [
        (s.read(other / s.HIDDEN_FILE), s.MAIN),
        (s.read(w.tree(s.MAIN) / s.HIDDEN_FILE), s.MAIN),
        (s.bash(f"cat {s.q(other / s.HIDDEN_FILE)}"), s.WT_OWN),
        (s.bash(f"grep -r {s.WORD} {s.q(w.sandbox.home)}"), s.MAIN),
        (s.bash(f"find {s.q(w.sandbox.runs)} -exec cat {{}} +"), s.MAIN),
        (s.bash(f"git -C {s.q(other)} grep -n {s.HIDDEN_WORD}"), s.CLONE),
        (s.read(w.tree(s.MAIN) / "README.md"), s.CLONE),
    ]
    for call, root in calls:
        t0 = time.monotonic()
        r = w.ask(call, s.ENGINEER, s.ENG, w.tree(root))
        print(f"{time.monotonic() - t0:.2f}s {root}: {call} -> {r.describe()[:200]}")
    for call in (s.bash(f"git show {st.revs['hidden']}"), s.bash(f"git cat-file -p {st.revs['hidden']}:{s.HIDDEN_FILE}"),
                 s.bash(f"git show {st.revs['hidden']}:{s.HIDDEN_FILE}")):
        r = st.ask(call, s.ENGINEER, s.ENG, st.tree(s.STORE_WT))
        print(f"store: {call} -> {r.describe()[:200]}")
    m = s.Modes()
    m.lock(w.sandbox.runs)
    print("runs unreadable:", s.unreadable(w.sandbox.runs))
    m.restore()
finally:
    shutil.rmtree(base, ignore_errors=True)
    print("removed", base, base.exists())
